en: Black-and-white photographic postcard showing a large corner building in a European city, with a tram-lined street and pedestrians. The multi-story structure has steep, complex roofs and decorative façades. Storefronts on the ground floor include a shop marked "ALBERT KERN" and fashion-related signage. The building's rounded corner bears the name "Rosseggerhaus". In the lower left margin, the caption reads "Graz, Rosseggerhaus." The scene depicts an early–20th-century urban streetscape with trams, cars, and people in period clothing.
